assumptions: Natural Earth 1:110m outlines are display context only; not model inputs or flood evidence.
Source timestamp is acquisition of the cartographic file, not imagery observation time.
Country labels are inferred from the centre of each recorded event bounding box; they do not describe every chip or replace publisher metadata.
Small islands and border detail may be omitted at this map scale. Unmatched centres remain unlabelled.
SVG coordinates use the same equirectangular longitude/latitude transform as the Studio plot, rounded to 0.01 display units.
